$comment: Pinned mci-agent warm-baseline for CRS G6 interim measurement. Source: docs/NIGHTLY_LOG.md line 578 (cycle 8.30 partial live sample, 2026-06-02): cpu_pct_micro=2516 (0.2516% of one core), rss_bytes=38715392 (~36.9 MB). This is the M4-ENGAGED posture (killOcrEmit=true per PR #266, cycle 8.28). Once V2-P1 M4-lift ships (PR #28 pending Amy's Mac), a second baseline row for the M4-LIFTED posture will be added. Drift envelope is ±3x — anything worse trips --strict (CI mode). The envelope is deliberately loose: a warm-agent baseline is noise-dominated and we care about class-shifts (0.25% → 5%), not micro-drift.
